title: Boston Gas Company d/b/a KeySpan Energy Delivery New England submits for review and approval by the Department of Telecommunications a 365-Day Firm Transportation Agreement with Massachusetts Port Authority.
petitioner: Boston Gas Company d/b/a National Grid
filings: The Department of Telecommunications and Energy APPROVES he proposed Agreement. The Department also finds that the pricing terms of the Agreement are competitively sensitive, and therefore GRANTS the Company's request for protection from public disclosure. Commissioners participating were: Judith F. Judson, Chairman; Commissioners James Connelly, W. Robert Keating and Brian Paul Golden. (D.T.E. 06-GC-13)
